scripts.e2e: pnpm build && vitest run -c e2e/vitest.config.ts e2e/free
scripts.e2e:agent: pnpm build && vitest run -c e2e/vitest.config.ts e2e/agent
scripts.e2e:linux: pnpm build && vitest run -c e2e/vitest.config.ts e2e/linux
scripts.e2e:linux:login: docker build -q -t openfabriq-e2e-linux e2e/linux && docker run -it --rm -v openfabriq-e2e-home:/home/dev openfabriq-e2e-linux claude
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/studio/app && pnpm --filter @openfabriq/relay typecheck && pnpm --filter @openfabriq/docs typecheck
